user.title: Set up SwitchSwap
user.description: SwitchSwap helps you replace broken devices. After setup, all functions are available under **Configure**.

prepare.title: Mark device for replacement
prepare.description: Entity IDs, names, icons, areas, labels, aliases and settings of the device are saved. Afterwards the device can be removed and the replacement paired.

data_description.remove_device: Removes the device from its integration (if supported) and from Home Assistant. If unchecked, it is deleted when the swap is completed.

mapping.title: Map entities

data.update_automations: Replace device IDs in automations.yaml / scripts.yaml

cancel.title: Discard swap
cancel.description: The saved data will be deleted. A device that was already removed is not restored.

error.already_pending: A swap is already pending for this device.
error.same_device: Old and new device must not be the same.
error.duplicate_target: A new entity was assigned to more than one old entity.

abort.prepared: {device} was saved with {count} entities. Now pair the replacement – SwitchSwap will report it under Settings → Repairs.
abort.completed: Swap completed: {old} → {new}. {mapped} entities transferred, {skipped} not mapped. See notifications for details.

init.title: Is {device} a replacement?
init.description: A device swap is pending. Should **{device}** replace a pending device?

mapping.title: Map entities

data.update_automations: Replace device IDs in automations.yaml / scripts.yaml

error.same_device: Old and new device must not be the same.
error.duplicate_target: A new entity was assigned to more than one old entity.

abort.device_not_found: The new device no longer exists.

prepare_swap.name: Mark device for replacement
prepare_swap.description: Saves all entities and settings of a device and optionally removes it.

remove_device.name: Delete device
remove_device.description: Remove the device from its integration and Home Assistant right away.

complete_swap.name: Complete swap
complete_swap.description: Transfers the saved entities and settings to the new device.

old_device_id.name: Old device ID
old_device_id.description: ID of the pending device (see the list_pending action).

update_automations.name: Update automations
update_automations.description: Replace device IDs in automations.yaml and scripts.yaml (a backup is created).

mapping.name: Mapping
mapping.description: Optional: old entity_id → new entity_id. Mapped automatically if omitted.

list_pending.name: List pending swaps
list_pending.description: Returns all pending swaps as a response.
